WELCOME TO NUMBERTOWN

A whole little world.
From every angle.

Meet thirty-one friends, from Zero to Thirty. Zero is a floating smile; the other friends are made from real, equal-sized cubes. Cross three river bridges between fifty west-bank and twenty east-bank homes. Count eighteen Ferris wheel cabins, play football, and climb Sunny Hill for a sea view. Visit the giant Rubik’s cube balancing on one corner and spinning in the square and the big duck pond. Follow the paved Mountain trail as it circles a peak up to a high viewing deck. Walk with WASD or choose Follow trail; movement keys take over at any time.

F / MKick the football / open town map
WASDWalk (arrow keys work too)
Drag QRRotate the camera
Scroll +−Zoom in and out
SpaceDo a happy little hop
TTransform into another rectangle
KHear a fact about your number
E / CChange feeling / reset camera
1–90Friends One to Ten
Shift + 1–90Friends Eleven to Twenty
Tab + numberChoose any friend, 0–30

Click a friend in town or a numbered thumbnail below. From the town, press Tab, type 0–30, then press Enter. You can also hold Tab, type the number, and release Tab to choose. Tab moves normally between buttons and fields elsewhere. Use Tab + 0 to choose Zero, a little floating smile with no blocks. Press T to try different rectangles and return to the original shape. Zero has no blocks to rearrange. Wide shapes need open space; press T again for the next arrangement if one does not fit. Twenty-Seven begins as a 3 × 3 × 3 cube, and Twenty-Eight has five openings. Unselected friends wander quietly between destinations. Only your selected friend shares math facts. Press K or use the math button to hear another. The bottom bar scrolls through all thirty-one friends; the arrows choose the previous or next friend. For Twenty-One, try View backpack to see the camping gear. Voices are optional; speech bubbles always work. Hold Shift while walking for a faster stroll.
